# Parameter reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.rb — do not edit by hand. -->

Every parameter of the `wardrobe` object type. All dimensions are millimetres
(`Float`). The editor is in Slovak, so each row also shows the label you see on
screen. Nested objects use dotted paths (`top.thickness`), list items use `[]`
(`columns[].cells[].content`). Presets are partial JSON of exactly these keys.

## Rozmery (`dims`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `placement` | enum | `between_walls` | Osadenie | Where the wardrobe stands: between two walls, in a left/right corner, or free standing. Only pre-fills the wall gaps.<br>Values: `between_walls` · `corner_left` · `corner_right` · `free` |
| `width` | number (mm) | `2000` | Šírka (vonkajšia) | Overall outside width, including cover strips and wall gaps.<br>Range: min 200, max 10000 |
| `height` | number (mm) | `2400` | Výška (vonkajšia) | Overall outside height, floor to top (including the base and the gap under the ceiling).<br>Range: min 200, max 4000 |
| `depth` | number (mm) | `600` | Hĺbka (vonkajšia) | Overall outside depth.<br>Range: min 100, max 1500 |
| `depth_includes_fronts` | boolean | `true` | Hĺbka vrátane čiel | When on, the fronts are inside the given depth; when off, the carcass alone is that deep. |
| `gap_left` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie od steny vľavo | Gap between the wall and the carcass on the left.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `gap_right` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie od steny vpravo | Gap between the wall and the carcass on the right.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `filler_left` | boolean | `false` | Zaslepovacia lišta vľavo | Fill the left wall gap with a filler strip. |
| `filler_right` | boolean | `false` | Zaslepovacia lišta vpravo | Fill the right wall gap with a filler strip. |
| `gap_top` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie od stropu | Gap between the top of the carcass and the ceiling.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `top_strip` | boolean | `false` | Krycia lišta hore | Cover the ceiling gap with a strip. |
| `top_strip_height` | number (mm) | `0` | Výška hornej lišty (0 = celé odsadenie) | Height of the top cover strip; 0 uses the whole ceiling gap.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `top_strip_setback` | number (mm) | `0` | Zapustenie hornej lišty od čiel | How far the top strip sits behind the front plane.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `base_type` | enum | `legs` | Spodok (nožičky / sokel medzi bokmi / na podlahe) | Base: adjustable legs, a plinth board between the sides, or the carcass standing on the floor.<br>Values: `legs` · `plinth` · `floor` |
| `base_height` | number (mm) | `100` | Výška spodku | Height of the base (legs or plinth).<br>Range: min 0, max 400 |
| `bottom_strip` | boolean | `true` | Krycia lišta dole (sokel) | Add a plinth board in front of the legs. |
| `bottom_strip_setback` | number (mm) | `50` | Zapustenie sokla od čiel | How far the plinth sits behind the front plane (toe kick).<br>Range: min 0 |
| `strip_floor_clearance` | number (mm) | `10` | Medzera sokla od podlahy | Gap between the plinth and the floor.<br>Range: min 0 |

## Konštrukcia (`construction`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `panel_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka korpusu (všeobecná) | Default carcass panel thickness.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `front_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka čiel | Thickness of doors and drawer fronts.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `back_thickness` | number (mm) | `3` | Hrúbka zadnej steny (HDF) | Thickness of the back panel (HDF).<br>Range: min 1, max 30 |
| `shelf_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka políc | Thickness of shelves.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `partition_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka priečok | Thickness of vertical partitions between columns.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `strip_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka líšt | Thickness of cover and filler strips.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `top` | object | — | Strop | Top panel: thickness, corner joints and recesses. |
| `top.thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka | Material thickness of this panel.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `top.corner_left` | enum | `inset` | Ľavý roh (medzi bokmi / cez bok) | Left corner joint: inset between the sides, or overlaying the side.<br>Values: `inset` · `overlay` |
| `top.corner_right` | enum | `inset` | Pravý roh (medzi bokmi / cez bok) | Right corner joint: inset between the sides, or overlaying the side.<br>Values: `inset` · `overlay` |
| `top.engagement` | number (mm) | `0` | Zapustenie do boku | How far the panel is let into the side panels.<br>Range: min 0, max 20 |
| `top.front_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vpredu | How far the panel sits behind the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `top.back_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vzadu | How far the panel stops short of the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `bottom` | object | — | Dno | Bottom panel: thickness, corner joints and recesses. |
| `bottom.thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka | Material thickness of this panel.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `bottom.corner_left` | enum | `inset` | Ľavý roh (medzi bokmi / cez bok) | Left corner joint: inset between the sides, or overlaying the side.<br>Values: `inset` · `overlay` |
| `bottom.corner_right` | enum | `inset` | Pravý roh (medzi bokmi / cez bok) | Right corner joint: inset between the sides, or overlaying the side.<br>Values: `inset` · `overlay` |
| `bottom.engagement` | number (mm) | `0` | Zapustenie do boku | How far the panel is let into the side panels.<br>Range: min 0, max 20 |
| `bottom.front_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vpredu | How far the panel sits behind the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `bottom.back_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vzadu | How far the panel stops short of the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `side_left` | object | — | Ľavý bok | Left side panel. |
| `side_left.thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka | Material thickness of this panel.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `side_left.front_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vpredu | How far the panel sits behind the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `side_left.back_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vzadu | How far the panel stops short of the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `side_right` | object | — | Pravý bok | Right side panel. |
| `side_right.thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka | Material thickness of this panel.<br>Range: min 3, max 60 |
| `side_right.front_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vpredu | How far the panel sits behind the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `side_right.back_recess` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie vzadu | How far the panel stops short of the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `back_mode` | enum | `groove` | Zadná stena (v drážke / nalozená / priznaná) | Back panel: HDF in a groove, HDF applied on the back, or a thick board inset between the sides.<br>Values: `groove` · `overlay` · `inset` |
| `groove_depth` | number (mm) | `8` | Hĺbka drážky | Depth of the groove that holds the back panel.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `groove_offset` | number (mm) | `12` | Drážka od zadnej hrany | Distance of the groove from the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `back_inset_thickness` | number (mm) | `18` | Hrúbka priznanej zadnej steny | Thickness of the inset (visible) back board.<br>Range: min 3 |
| `shelf_setback` | number (mm) | `2` | Zapustenie políc vpredu | How far shelves sit behind the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `shelf_back_clearance` | number (mm) | `0` | Vôľa políc vzadu | Gap between shelves and the back panel.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `line_drilling` | boolean | `false` | Rad otvorov (systém 32) | Record system-32 shelf-pin drilling on sides and partitions (reported in the cut list). |
| `drill_pitch` | number (mm) | `32` | Rozteč otvorov | Distance between shelf-pin holes.<br>Range: min 1 |
| `drill_offset_front` | number (mm) | `37` | Rad od prednej hrany | Distance of the front hole row from the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `drill_offset_back` | number (mm) | `37` | Rad od zadnej hrany | Distance of the rear hole row from the rear edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `drill_start` | number (mm) | `100` | Prvý otvor od dna | Height of the first hole above the bottom.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `drill_end_offset` | number (mm) | `100` | Posledný otvor od stropu | Distance of the last hole below the top.<br>Range: min 0 |

## Čelá a špáry (`fronts`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `front_gap_h` | number (mm) | `3` | Špára medzi čelami vodorovne | Gap between neighbouring fronts, horizontally.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `front_gap_v` | number (mm) | `3` | Špára medzi čelami zvisle | Gap between stacked fronts, vertically.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `reveal_top` | number (mm) | `2` | Odsadenie čela od hornej hrany | How much shorter the front is at the top edge of the carcass.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `reveal_bottom` | number (mm) | `0` | Odsadenie čela od spodnej hrany | How much shorter the front is at the bottom edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `reveal_left` | number (mm) | `2` | Odsadenie čela od ľavej hrany | How much narrower the front is at the left side.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `reveal_right` | number (mm) | `2` | Odsadenie čela od pravej hrany | How much narrower the front is at the right side.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `inset_depth` | number (mm) | `2` | Zapustenie vnorených čiel | How deep inset fronts sit inside the carcass.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `front_grain` | enum | `vertical` | Smer dekoru čiel | Grain direction of fronts (affects the cut list).<br>Values: `vertical` · `horizontal` |

## Dvere (`doors`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `doors_enabled` | boolean | `true` | Dvere (vypnuté = otvorený korpus) | Turn doors off for an open carcass (shelving unit). |
| `doors` | object | — | Predvolené dvere | Default door settings; a column can override them. |
| `doors.type` | enum | `double` | Typ dverí | Type.<br>Values: `none` · `single_left` · `single_right` · `double` · `flap_up` |
| `doors.mount` | enum | `overlay` | Uloženie čiel | Front mounting: overlay, half overlay or inset.<br>Values: `overlay` · `half_overlay` · `inset` |
| `door_display` | enum | `closed` | Zobrazenie dverí | Draw doors closed or open (visual only, model side).<br>Values: `closed` · `open` |
| `open_angle` | number | `90` | Uhol otvorenia | Opening angle used when doors are drawn open.<br>Range: min 0, max 180 |
| `door_max_width` | number (mm) | `600` | Max. odporúčaná šírka krídla | Width above which a single door leaf gets a warning.<br>Range: min 100 |
| `hinge_table` | string | `900:2,1600:3,2100:4,9999:5` | Pánty: do výšky:počet, … | Hinge count per door height: "max height:count, ..." (e.g. 900:2,1600:3). |

## Úchytky (`handles`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `handle` | object | — | Predvolená úchytka | Default handle; a column can override it. |
| `handle.type` | enum | `profile` | Typ úchytky | Type.<br>Values: `none` · `drilled` · `profile` |
| `handle.hole_spacing` | number (mm) | `160` | Rozteč otvorov | Handle hole spacing (centre to centre).<br>Range: min 0 |
| `handle.offset_edge` | number (mm) | `30` | Odsadenie od hrany | Handle distance from the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `handle.orientation` | enum | `horizontal` | Orientácia | Handle orientation.<br>Values: `horizontal` · `vertical` |
| `handle.profile_height` | number (mm) | `30` | Výška profilu (skráti čelo) | Height of the integrated handle profile; the front is shortened by it.<br>Range: min 0, max 100 |
| `handle.profile_position` | enum | `top` | Pozícia profilu | Whether the handle profile runs along the top or the bottom edge.<br>Values: `top` · `bottom` |

## Zásuvky (`drawers`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `drawer_system` | enum | `blum_legrabox` | Systém zásuviek | Drawer system used for all drawers (front only, wooden box, or a Blum system).<br>Values: `front_only` · `wood_box` · `blum_legrabox` · `blum_tandembox` · `blum_merivobox` |
| `drawer_box_thickness` | number (mm) | `16` | Hrúbka bokov/zadného dielu boxu | Thickness of wooden drawer sides / metal-box back panel.<br>Range: min 3 |
| `drawer_bottom_thickness` | number (mm) | `3` | Drevený box – hrúbka dna | Thickness of the wooden drawer bottom.<br>Range: min 1 |
| `drawer_bottom_groove` | number (mm) | `6` | Drevený box – drážka dna | Groove depth that holds the wooden drawer bottom.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `metal_box_bottom_thickness` | number (mm) | `16` | Kovový box – hrúbka dna | Thickness of the bottom used in metal drawer boxes.<br>Range: min 3 |
| `drawer_depth_reserve` | number (mm) | `20` | Rezerva hĺbky za zásuvkou | Clearance kept behind the runner when picking its nominal length.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `inner_drawer_setback` | number (mm) | `30` | Vnorená zásuvka – zapustenie čela | How far an inner drawer front sits behind the doors.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `inner_drawer_side_gap` | number (mm) | `3` | Vnorená zásuvka – bočná špára | Side clearance of an inner drawer front.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `drawer_systems` | object | — | Tabuľky systémov | Editable catalogue tables of the drawer systems (verify against the current manufacturer catalogue). |

| `drawer_systems.blum_merivobox.front_min_extra` | number (mm) | `0` | Min. presah čela nad výšku triedy | Minimum extra front height above the height class.<br>Range: min 0 |

## Stĺpce (`columns`)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Label in the editor (Slovak) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns[]` | list | — | Stĺpce (zľava doprava) | Columns from left to right; each holds cells from top to bottom. |
| `columns[].width_mode` | enum | `auto` | Šírka – režim | How the column width is given: auto, fixed mm, or a ratio of the remaining space.<br>Values: `auto` · `mm` · `ratio` |
| `columns[].width` | number (mm) | `1` | Šírka (mm / pomer) | Column width value (mm or ratio, depending on the mode).<br>Range: min 0 |
| `columns[].doors_override` | boolean | `false` | Vlastné nastavenie dverí | Use door settings of this column instead of the global ones. |
| `columns[].doors` | object | — | Dvere |  |
| `columns[].doors.type` | enum | `double` | Typ dverí | Type.<br>Values: `none` · `single_left` · `single_right` · `double` · `flap_up` |
| `columns[].doors.mount` | enum | `overlay` | Uloženie čiel | Front mounting: overlay, half overlay or inset.<br>Values: `overlay` · `half_overlay` · `inset` |
| `columns[].handle_override` | boolean | `false` | Vlastná úchytka | Use a handle setting of this column instead of the global one. |
| `columns[].handle` | object | — | Úchytka |  |
| `columns[].handle.type` | enum | `profile` | Typ úchytky | Type.<br>Values: `none` · `drilled` · `profile` |
| `columns[].handle.hole_spacing` | number (mm) | `160` | Rozteč otvorov | Handle hole spacing (centre to centre).<br>Range: min 0 |
| `columns[].handle.offset_edge` | number (mm) | `30` | Odsadenie od hrany | Handle distance from the front edge.<br>Range: min 0 |
| `columns[].handle.orientation` | enum | `horizontal` | Orientácia | Handle orientation.<br>Values: `horizontal` · `vertical` |
| `columns[].handle.profile_height` | number (mm) | `30` | Výška profilu (skráti čelo) | Height of the integrated handle profile; the front is shortened by it.<br>Range: min 0, max 100 |
| `columns[].handle.profile_position` | enum | `top` | Pozícia profilu | Whether the handle profile runs along the top or the bottom edge.<br>Values: `top` · `bottom` |
| `columns[].cells[]` | list | — | Polia (zhora nadol) | Cells of this column, top to bottom. |
| `columns[].cells[].height_mode` | enum | `auto` | Výška – režim | How the cell height is given: auto, fixed mm, or a ratio.<br>Values: `auto` · `mm` · `ratio` |
| `columns[].cells[].height` | number (mm) | `1` | Výška (mm / pomer) | Cell height value (mm or ratio, depending on the mode).<br>Range: min 0 |
| `columns[].cells[].content` | enum | `shelves` | Obsah | What the cell holds: adjustable shelves, a hanging rail, drawers, inner drawers, or nothing.<br>Values: `shelves` · `rod` · `drawers` · `inner_drawers` · `empty` |
| `columns[].cells[].shelves_count` | integer | `2` | Počet políc | Number of adjustable shelves in the cell.<br>Range: min 0, max 30 |
| `columns[].cells[].drawers_count` | integer | `3` | Počet zásuviek | Number of drawers in the cell.<br>Range: min 1, max 12 |
| `columns[].cells[].drawer_heights` | string | — | Výšky čiel zhora (mm, čiarkou; prázdne = rovnomerne) | Front heights from the top, comma separated; empty spreads them evenly. |
| `columns[].cells[].rod_offset_top` | number (mm) | `60` | Tyč – odsadenie zhora | Distance of the hanging rail below the top of the cell.<br>Range: min 0 |

| `edge_shelf` | enum | `front` | Hrany – police, priečky | Edge banding rule for shelves and partitions.<br>Values: `none` · `front` · `all` |
| `edge_front` | enum | `all` | Hrany – čelá | Edge banding rule for doors and drawer fronts.<br>Values: `none` · `front` · `all` |
| `edge_strip` | enum | `all` | Hrany – lišty | Edge banding rule for cover and filler strips.<br>Values: `none` · `front` · `all` |
